parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Complete the electronic configurations of a $\text{Cu}^{+}$ ion and a $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ion.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why transition elements have variable oxidation states.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Aqueous copper(II) sulfate, $\text{CuSO}_{4}$, contains the $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_{2}\text{O})_{6}]^{2+}$ complex ion.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
A few drops of $\text{NH}_{3}\text{(aq)}$ are added to $\text{CuSO}_{4}\text{(aq)}$.

Describe any observations made.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction taking place.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
An **excess** of $\text{NH}_{3}\text{(aq)}$ is added to $\text{CuSO}_{4}\text{(aq)}$.

Describe any further observations made.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction taking place.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: State the name for the type of reaction taking place.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Copper metal can be oxidised by acidified $\text{KMnO}_{4}$. The relevant half-equations and their standard electrode potentials, $E^{\ominus}$, are shown.

$$\text{Cu}^{2+} + 2\text{e}^{-} \rightleftharpoons \text{Cu} \qquad E^{\ominus} = +0.34\text{ V}$$

$$\text{MnO}_{4}^{-} + 8\text{H}^{+} + 5\text{e}^{-} \rightleftharpoons \text{Mn}^{2+} + 4\text{H}_{2}\text{O} \qquad E^{\ominus} = +1.52\text{ V}$$

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
A $\text{MnO}_{4}^{-}/\text{Mn}^{2+}$ electrode is constructed using $0.0020\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{MnO}_{4}^{-}$, $1.0\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{Mn}^{2+}$ and $1.0\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{H}^{+}$. The temperature used is $298\text{ K}$.

Use the Nernst equation to show that the $E$ value for this $\text{MnO}_{4}^{-}/\text{Mn}^{2+}$ electrode is $+1.49\text{ V}$.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
An electrochemical cell is constructed using a standard $\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu}$ electrode and the $\text{MnO}_{4}^{-}/\text{Mn}^{2+}$ electrode described in **(d)(i)**.

Calculate the value of $E_{\text{cell}}$.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction taking place in the electrochemical cell described in **(d)(ii)**.

parts.label: (d)(iv)
parts.text:
Complete the sentences for the electrochemical cell described in (d)(ii).

The … electrode is the negative electrode. Electrons flow from the … electrode to the … electrode when the cell is in use.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
A solution containing $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_{2}\text{O})_{6}]^{2+}$ is electrolysed for 5.00 hours using a constant electric current. 0.764 g of copper metal is formed at the cathode. No other reduction reaction takes place.

Calculate the electric current, in A, used. Give your answer to **three** significant figures.
